messages.subject: can not get colored plot by specifying colour argument
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to have your helps on correcting my codes of ggplot2. I
can not got my plot colored. I can not do that by myself.

I want the bar plot, with type as the x, percent as y, and the bar was
colored by type. And also, the bar plot should be faceted by group.

Thanks a lot in advance.

###################
# (1) my code 1, workable, but not correctly colored
p1 <- qplot(type, data = anno.type, geom = "bar", weight=percent,
colour = type) + facet_grid(group ~.)+ opts(axis.text.x =
theme_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 8))


###################
# (2) my code 2, can not work
p2 <- ggplot(data=anno.type, aes_string(x=type, y=percent)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity")
+ opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size =
8,colour = "grey50"))
+ facet_grid(group ~.)

messages.subject: Re: can not get colored plot by specifying colour argument
parts:
Hi,

Please avoid using "group" for the column name of data.frame.

anno.type = rename(anno.type, c(group = "Group"))
p1 <- qplot(type, data = anno.type, geom = "bar", weight = percent,

but this bug is fixed in the next version of ggplot2.

kohske
